brief.summary_1line: King Trishanku asks Vasishtha’s sons to perform a sacrifice; they angrily curse him into a chandala, after which he seeks refuge with Vishwamitra.

image_candidates.scene_text: The hundred sons of Vasishtha glare in fury as they curse King Trishanku, their hands raised in a forest hermitage.
By morning Trishanku stands transformed—darkened, emaciated, ash-smeared, shaven-headed, his golden ornaments turned to dull lead.
The fallen king, hands folded in supplication, pleads before the compassionate sage Vishwamitra in the wilderness.
